text:
rachel: Quick thread: compact sidebar prototype exposed a weird deeplink mapping issue. sharing notes before the design review.

rachel: Repro: open /teams/blue/workspaces/one/collections/77/item/metrics -> sidebar expands but highlights 'Collections' group not the 'Metrics' child.

tom: Looks like our nav resolver matches parent prefix before checking paramized child routes. short fix: change resolution order.

anya: Proposed: exact full-path match -> param-resolved map (with id decoding) -> alias redirects -> longestPrefix fallback. That should make child wins.

sam: Accessibility check: when deep-link lands on the child, keyboard focus should move to the child link and we must set aria-current="page" there. If group auto-expands, set aria-expanded="true" on the toggle and announce it.

rachel: UX copy: if we have to fallback to a group, show a subtle toast: "You were routed to the nearest page. Open the intended item" with a small link, dismissible. Show only when resolvedRoute != requestedRoute and user has access.

tom: Also canonicalize the URL to the resolved route via history.replaceState, and append ?via=orig for diagnostics. don't reload.

anya: Normalizer: strip hashes, trim trailing slash, decode percent-encoding, lowercase segments, stable-sort query keys except auth tokens.

sam: QA checklist: focus landing, aria announcements, canonicalize replaceState, banner suppression logic, slug collision unit tests.

rachel: Action items: @tom update resolver PR to exact->params->aliases->prefix; @anya write a11y snippet and paste here; @sam add QA ticket and test plan; rachel will upload two figma frames (current vs resolved-highlight).

nav-bot: Preview build: https://preview.redwood/nav/compact-clarity (ephemeral)

rachel: Thanks team :thumbsup: we'll validate in Friday sync.
